findings.mechanism: Any unreconciled row or prepare failure sets a global stopped flag before the native loop. reconstructComparisonPrediction requires final_context_selected, so a legitimate sealed run_error prevents scoring every otherwise prepared completed outcome.
findings.assessment: Conservative campaign behavior, not permission to change frozen scoring or claim success; a separately labeled post hoc descriptive diagnostic can retain useful survivor evidence.

findings.mechanism: The source identifier regex rejects every slash or backslash. The receipt-bound slot 02 public plan contains ordinary indexing/consumption and match/context language, not source paths. Replacing only the two slash separators with and yields three valid questions.
findings.assessment: Lexical validator false positive; original failed outcome and paid cost remain unchanged.

diagnostic_requirements: Wait for global generation terminal, durable seal/manifest and confirmed local process-group settlement. Bind the original report, freeze, all outcomes, receipts and sources before evaluator access.
Keep exactly twelve ordered rows and all known/unknown costs. A legitimately incomplete output receives no invented prediction, no quality credit and an explicit not-evaluable status.

Only independently reconciled, final_context_selected outcomes whose original receipt-bound selection and native prediction reconstruct exactly may be descriptively scored. Preserve every original artifact and frozen campaign result.

Explicitly distinguish expected incomplete statuses from completed-output reconstruction failure. Corrupt/missing/substituted evidence, base/task/source drift, receipt contradiction, unassigned spend, unsettled processes or global seal/config mismatch are integrity failures, not ordinary incompletion; stop before evaluator access.

Use separate bounded evaluator stage, unchanged native metrics, independent pre/post source reconstruction and evidence checks; an evaluator or storage failure stops later evaluation and retains all costs and rows.

Force campaign success, all-valid, accepted savings and benchmark-clearance claims false regardless of survivor metrics. Mark survivor selection bias and incomplete-arm ratios as descriptive arithmetic only.
Require a separately reviewed exact diagnostic implementation and protocol after settlement; this assessment is not evaluator execution admission.
general_planner_recommendations: Keep strict schema, bounded text, three distinct task-derived questions and isolated planner input. Treat broad punctuation bans as syntax heuristics rather than evidence-proven provenance controls.

Use narrowly defined high-confidence source identifier detection or an explicit provenance policy, with generic prose slash/backslash and path/code examples tested across tasks. Unknown or ambiguous lexical matches should not silently become asserted source leakage.

Preserve the original plan and failure; implement any validator revision additively and prospectively. Do not silently sanitize live plans, add retries, whitelist task-specific terms, or retrospectively count this failed arm as completed.
